purpose: Adaptive PC references from the LastUpdates and ReferenceAvatar pilots; preserve each approved character palette. Required skin controls are a destination-authoring contract, not an executed importer.

authority.stage: Export for VRChat after approved Rigging and facial authoring
authority.sourceWeights: Keep approved connected-source weights; repair them in Rigging when necessary.
authority.destinationChanges: Unity Humanoid calibration, fitted runtime adapters, materials, PhysBones and descriptor bindings belong to destination preparation.
authority.credentialsAndPublication: User handles sign-in and terms; publication requires explicit authorization.
authority.storage: Use a real user project directory outside application-package caches. Verify the physical destination, not only a junction or virtualized path.

projectIsolation.identity: Bind the FITA manifest projectId to an exclusive physical Unity directory and record it locally. Reuse only verified same-character projects; same-character versions may share that project.
projectIsolation.concurrency: Resolve junctions and check current editors/imports/builds before writing. Do not open the same project twice, delete active locks or interrupt another task. Separate characters may have separate projects open concurrently.
projectIsolation.sharedOutputs: Use character-and-revision-specific scenes, temporary files and local test-avatar build names, including VRChat shared output folders. Verify blueprint ownership before an authorized upload.
projectIsolation.evidence: Record verified project identity, physical path, source revision and isolation checks in the unity-project evidence. Guidance is not an automatic lock or proof of runtime isolation.

testedTools.rule: Historical tested versions. Recheck official VRChat compatibility and package sources before future installations; do not upgrade a working user project silently. Poiyomi Toon is free; Pro is not required for this profile.

facial.status: Required destination-authoring policy; implement and verify per character. This profile is not an executed Unity importer.

menuLanguage.scope: All avatar expression controls, submenus and puppet-axis display labels; independent of FITA UI and conversation language.
menuLanguage.question: Which language would you like for the avatar's expression buttons? English is the default.
menuLanguage.persistIn: Character-owned Unity configuration record, also cited in facial-bindings evidence

gaze.travelPolicy: Fit world-space travel to the actual eyelid aperture and inherited scale; 6.5 mm is a starting radius, not a universal guarantee.
gaze.planarEyeAdapter: Bounded lever with head-relative X/Y translation carrier, local Z disabled; iris, pupil and glints move rigidly together with corrected bindposes.
gaze.rotationPolicy: Read back valid neutral/directional quaternions via supported API or verified serialized properties. Never leave zero quaternions.

blink.offMode: Stable timed automatic blink; native gaze stays active
blink.modeIsolation: Mutually exclusive enabled flags on coordinated derived face renderers. Descriptor targets camera renderer; stable renderer native blink has zero deltas and a separate full automatic blink target.
blink.rejectedFilter: 0-35% blink deadzone worsened false closures; do not ship as a correction
blink.knownLimitation: Native Selfie input can falsely close eyes on downward gaze. The fallback isolates the visible face; it does not repair webcam detection. Real blink tracking must be tested in Camera mode.

speech.multiRendererRoute: Viseme Parameter Only with coordinated FX clips
speech.singleRendererRoute: Native viseme mapping only when all required parts demonstrably follow

expressions.cameraEmotionPolicy: Verify actual capabilities of the installed tracker/SDK; do not promise smile/sadness detection from menu aliases.

physics.units: Collider radii and endpoint lengths are measured in world metres, then transformed into the actual owner's local units. The pilot bone scale was about 158 despite a 1.58m avatar.
physics.curveMeaning: Curves multiply their scalar. x is the SDK's actual chain ratio; use CalcBoneRatio/CalcPull/CalcSpring/CalcMaxAngle or equivalent verified APIs, not index assumptions.
physics.curveInterpolation: new Keyframe points used zero tangents unless explicitly marked linear; preserve or report interpolation when adapting.

ponytails.note: Spring increased from .30 to .38 at user request; final return and bounce must still be assessed on each avatar. A fixed attachment does not mean several upper segments must be immobile.

frontLocks.note: Front locks have a milder profile and tighter facial clearance than ponytails.

skirtPanels.kinematicAdapter: Eight unweighted parent controls partially follow fitted thigh swing; child chains keep PhysBones. Front/rear following was fitted separately, not a universal fraction.
skirtPanels.limitation: Stationary crouch still penetrated thighs; movement improved. Collision components and following pivots do not prove vertex-surface clearance.

breastAndGluteAnchors.responseGoal: medium, user-requested; inspect actual connected surface weights before increasing forces
breastAndGluteAnchors.staticWeightEvidence: After the local smooth shared-centre repair, a controlled 16-degree pose displaced breast surfaces about 6.3mm and glutes about 4.0mm. These are static deformation measurements, not verified dynamic jiggle amplitude.

collisionRules: Fit capsule ends to the actual joints and preserve rest clearance; do not copy pilot positions.
Assign collider lists explicitly and verify effective world dimensions after inherited scale.
Keep grabbing, posing, stretch and squish disabled unless requested; cross-avatar interaction is separate from explicit local colliders.
A virtual endpoint is not an extra real bone. Single-bone anchors need an endpoint; nonuniform inherited scale needs a measured adapter.
Never let a constraint and a PhysBone write the same Transform; use a kinematic parent and simulated child.

materials.baselineStatus: Review11 built successfully and user reported a visible useful improvement. Further mask authoring and anisotropic hair recommendations are pending, not completed features.

hair.note: Hair is dielectric. Stylized anisotropy is a future fitted comparison, not enabled in the validated baseline.

outfit.note: Metallic multiplier is applied through a semantic metal mask, not to all fabric or boots.

outline.unitExplanation: Poiyomi divides _LineWidth by 100; world mode gives 0.45/0.6/0.8/0.9mm in this pilot. Do not multiply again by the FBX bone scale.
outline.note: Keep the dark outer silhouette; eye/glint layers do not need additional hull outlines. Vertex-color outline baking was not performed; preserve custom shading normals and existing attributes.

emission.note: No extra glow requested in Review11. Emission is separate from bloom; a visible halo depends on world/camera post-processing.

masks.authoring: Paint on the 3D model while storing separate mask images on the approved existing UVs; inspect the 2D atlas, seams, padding and mip levels. Preserve base albedo pixels and connected geometry.
masks.packedPBR: R metal, G smoothness, B reflection mask, A specular mask in _MochieMetallicMaps; data textures use sRGB off. Smoothness white means smoother/glossier; roughness has the opposite direction.
masks.SSS: _SSSThicknessMap RGB tints transmission, A stores thickness; the shader inverts A. The pilot used A=1-0.6*estimatedSkinCoverage and _SSSThicknessMod=0, an approximation rather than measured thickness. Author anatomical masks for production and inspect thin areas/backlighting.
masks.outline: Separate grayscale size mask, evaluated per vertex, preserves outer lines while reducing unwanted internal marks.
masks.pilotLimitation: The first masks were estimated from atlas colors. That incorrectly classified pale hair as metal; it was corrected by excluding hair from metal. Semantic masks per region are required before claiming production-quality separation.

buildDialogs: Thry: Automatic Lighting Fix can assign a common fitted probe anchor to renderers without one; inspect intentional existing anchors before enabling.
Locking Materials: normal shader optimization notice, not a paid trial or subscription. User presses OK; first compilation can take minutes.
Do not buy Pro or replace a shader just because an unused optional package preset mentions Pro; check the materials actually assigned to the avatar.
